fictional-single-renter.headline: Your recorded position
fictional-single-renter.summary: A view of your confirmed details, with gaps kept visible.

parts.does: This view keeps your current arrangements.
parts.why: Your recorded net worth is {@position.netWorth}.
parts.gives: Spare cash is {position.spareCash}; solvency is {position.solvency}. Recorded pressure points: {position.pressurePoints}.
parts.costs: Cash assigned to a reserve stays assigned.

parts.does: Assets already assigned are listed here: {ledger.crossedOff}.
parts.why: After the reserve, spare cash is {steps.reserve.cashAfter}.
parts.gives: After the retirement step, spare cash is {steps.goal_application_retire.cashAfter}.
parts.costs: Assigning cash limits its use elsewhere.

parts.does: The emergency reserve is {position.reserve}.
parts.why: The reserve uses {position.reserveMonths} months of spending.
parts.gives: Your recorded cash is kept visible alongside the reserve.
parts.costs: Reserve cash is kept aside from goal funding.

parts.does: This view lists the issues the code found.
parts.why: The list follows the recorded balances and rates.
parts.gives: No borrowing issue is listed in this position.
parts.costs: The view depends on the details supplied.
parts.check: Review changes in borrowing when you review the plan.

parts.does: Your retirement goal stays in this view.
parts.why: The goal is kept alongside the resources recorded.
parts.gives: The detail is shown with its available facts.
parts.costs: Goal funding can use resources needed elsewhere.
parts.check: The registered reasons keep missing results visible.

parts.does: The chosen funding description is {goals.goal_application_retire.chosenWay}.
parts.why: The current arrangements are retained.
parts.gives: Cash committed now is {goals.goal_application_retire.routeCash}.
parts.costs: Committed resources cannot also meet other goals.

parts.does: The current recorded cash remains visible.
parts.why: Goal funding must be priced before an after-goals result can be stated.
parts.gives: {limitations.cash_flow_after.leftOverAfterGoals.yearly}
parts.costs: This view cannot establish an additional spending budget.

parts.does: This view retains your current arrangements.
parts.why: Net worth comes from the compiled balance sheet.
parts.gives: Net worth is {@position.netWorth}.
parts.costs: A balance-sheet value does not establish that an asset is available as cash.

parts.does: The illustration uses the recorded facts.
parts.why: Income and spending can change.
parts.gives: The missing results remain visible beside the facts.
parts.costs: Those missing results limit what can be concluded.
parts.check: Review the position when circumstances change.

parts.does: Review the missing facts in this view.
parts.why: Those facts affect which results can be shown.
parts.gives: The code records the affected results.
parts.costs: Until those results exist, no extra spending amount is established.
